title: Convergent · Monitoring
description: Collection, evaluation, storage, log delivery and resource cost.

panels.title: Evaluation / ingestion
panels.description: Rule API includes every rule and group, with age bounded by twice its interval plus 90s. This stack cannot page while svc itself is unavailable; the bar shows unknown.

panels.title: Collectors - measurement age and result
panels.description: Minute: NTS, audit, rules, Internet and cgroups. Hourly: storage and failed daily retry. Daily: hardware/certificates (20h overdue threshold). Boot: valid only within this boot. Failure reasons are in facts syslog.

panels.title: Scrapes - cost and availability
panels.description: Incus runs at 60s; all other scrapes 30s with a 5s timeout. Payload allowlists limit stored families.

panels.title: Firewall collection sections
panels.description: A failed command is explicit. Parser/required-field failures also clear the aggregate firewall collection verdict.

panels.title: Textfiles - source age
panels.description: Raw age includes files whose producers have stopped. Boot age alone is not a failure.

panels.title: Log sender heartbeats - last 5m
panels.description: One minute heartbeat per host/firewall/WAN. Four rows expected; absent rows mean missing delivery, not quiet logs. Sender identity is the connection address.

targets.expr: _time:5m app_name:="cv-heartbeat" remote_ip:in("100.80.1.10","100.80.2.2","100.80.2.3","100.80.0.10") | stats by (remote_ip) count() as heartbeats

panels.title: Evaluation / remote-write errors
panels.description: Counter changes over 5m; errors must remain zero. Monitoring alerts remain fallible if their own evaluator is failing.

panels.title: svc cgroup - actual memory constraint
panels.description: Host cgroup memory.current includes cache; compare idle against 350 MiB and admin-browser sessions against 768 MiB. Go/cache budgets are not RSS limits.

panels.title: svc processes - RSS / Go heap
panels.description: Native process metrics, bounded to monitoring processes. Grafana RSS is included only in cgroup totals.

panels.title: Guest OOM / throttling
panels.description: Fixed container cgroups: svc and browser compartments. Counters reset when a cgroup is recreated.

panels.title: Guest pressure
panels.description: Cgroup PSI total stall seconds per second; some/full scope remains distinct.

panels.title: Monitoring errors
panels.description: svc local syslog is forwarded over loopback UDP to VictoriaLogs and retained for 7d / 2 GiB threshold. RAM ring remains the fallback while VL is down; UDP is not durable.

targets.expr: (remote_ip:="127.0.0.1" AND severity:in("0","1","2","3","4")) OR (remote_ip:in("100.80.1.10","100.80.2.2","100.80.2.3","100.80.0.10","127.0.0.1") AND (severity:in("0","1","2","3","4") OR level:in("emerg","alert","crit","error","err","warn","warning")) AND NOT _msg:~"(?i)(type=(EXECVE|SYSCALL|CWD|PATH|PROCTITLE)|type=13(00|02|07|09|27))" AND NOT (app_name:="kernel" AND _msg:~"^([[:space:]]|Call [Tt]race:|CPU: [0-9]|Hardware name:|Modules linked in:|RIP:|RSP:|R[A-Z0-9]{2}:|EFLAGS:|FS:|GS:|CS:|CR[0-9]:|PKRU:|Code:|---\\[ end trace|</?(TASK|IRQ|NMI)>|[? ]*[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\\+0x[0-9a-f]+/0x)") AND app_name:in("facts","observe","syslog-ng")) | copy remote_ip as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.1.10") "host" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.2.2") "fw1" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.2.3") "fw2" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.0.10") "wan" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="127.0.0.1") "svc" as hostname | set_stream_fields hostname, app_name

panels.title: Retained log window / storage headroom
panels.description: Effective oldest retained record, not a retention guarantee. Filesystem free space does not replace qgroup headroom on Host.

targets.cvOptional: No logs have been stored yet.

panels.title: Ingestion / query failures
panels.description: Rejected samples, logs and query/proxy errors; do not interpret missing lazily-created counters as proof of health.

targets.cvOptional: Some failure counters are created only after the first error; required read-only and process metrics remain checked.

panels.title: Native collectors - result and cost
panels.description: Exporter collector failures alert even when HTTP scraping succeeds.

panels.title: Go GC pause cost
panels.description: Mean GC pause duration; compare with process RSS and the actual cgroup limit before changing memory budgets.

targets.cvOptional: No GC cycles yet produces an undefined mean.

panels.title: Not collected
panels.description: Collection boundaries: scrape.yaml, tools/facts, tools/check, fw-facts and wan-check.

options.content: Metrics: 7d, no dedup. Logs: 7d / 2 GiB threshold, 6 GiB quota. Quota usage is on Host. No remote paging or durable svc log queue; sender heartbeats detect loss of delivery, not queue depth. Measure idle/admin-browser memory and GC on the rig before changing budgets.

target.expr: remote_ip:in("100.80.2.2","100.80.2.3") AND _msg:~"carp[0-9]+:.*(MASTER|BACKUP|INIT) -> (MASTER|BACKUP|INIT)" | copy remote_ip as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.1.10") "host" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.2.2") "fw1" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.2.3") "fw2" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.0.10") "wan" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="127.0.0.1") "svc" as hostname | set_stream_fields hostname, app_name
